content:
The area of a sector is proportional to its central angle, so the probability equals the sector’s angle divided by \(360^\circ\).

The angles on the right side of the shaded sector add to
\[
35^\circ+30^\circ+20^\circ=85^\circ.
\]
The unshaded angle on the left side is
\[
40^\circ.
\]
Since the upper half of the disk corresponds to a straight angle of \(180^\circ\), the shaded sector has angle
\[
180^\circ-85^\circ-40^\circ=55^\circ.
\]
Thus the probability is
\[
\frac{55}{360}=\frac{11}{72}.
\]

\[
\boxed{\frac{11}{72}}
\]
